connection.addToken: Add token to unlock live data

overview.title: Control center
overview.subtitle: A single operating surface for repositories, builds, releases, and project health.
overview.connectTitle: Connect GitHub to populate this workspace
overview.connectDetail: Set GITHUB_TOKEN in .env, restart the API, then sync repositories. The interface stays empty until it has real data.

activityPanel.title: Recent activity
activityPanel.emptyDetail: Repository syncs and build actions are recorded as they happen.

empty.projectsDetail: Sync authorized GitHub repositories to make this surface useful.
empty.tasksDetail: Syncing repositories and dispatching builds will create durable task records.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Every repository keeps its own branch, build, release, and deployment context.
projects.emptyDetail: Use Sync repositories after configuring a GitHub token. Public and private access follow the token's scope.

monitoring.title: Monitoring
monitoring.subtitle: A compact view of repository activity and the execution signals NEXUS already knows.
monitoring.noSynthetic: No synthetic uptime data is shown.
monitoring.emptyDetail: Import repositories to create real health records.

connections.title: GitHub Connections
connections.subtitle: Keep legacy token compatibility while moving repository access toward scoped GitHub App installations.
connections.legacyDetail: The current GITHUB_TOKEN path remains available for local development. App installations add scoped repository access and short-lived tokens without sending a private key to the browser.
connections.tokenOnUse: token will be refreshed on use
connections.noInstallationsDetail: Configure the App credentials, install it for an account, then refresh this page.

security.title: Security Center
security.subtitle: Review the operations that changed external state and the evidence recorded for each one.

roleCard.title: Role model
roleCard.detail: Viewer reads. Operator queues builds, scans, and drafts. Administrator publishes and changes authorization.

webhookCard.title: Webhook evidence
webhookCard.detail: HMAC verification, delivery IDs, and event lifecycle records prevent duplicate or unsigned updates.

releaseCard.title: Release evidence
releaseCard.detail: Version checks, asset digests, and explicit confirmation are recorded before publishing.

security.noAuditDetail: High-impact operations will appear here after they are executed.

serverSettings.title: Server settings
serverSettings.subtitle: Environment-backed configuration keeps credentials out of browser state and project records.
serverSettings.credentialsDetail: Tokens are read from environment variables and never returned to the browser.
serverSettings.refDetail: Dispatch requests use the selected repository's default branch unless overridden.
serverSettings.guardsTitle: Release and PR actions are guarded
serverSettings.guardsDetail: High-impact GitHub writes require route-level gates and explicit confirmation; remote writes stay disabled by default.
